### False Messiahs, Wars, and Natural Disasters
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/false-messiahs-wars-and-natural-disasters
Passage: Mark 13:5-8
Points:
- The predicted fall of the temple marked the end of the Mosaic sacrificial system and the arrival of the new covenant.
- The disciples recognized that the destruction of the temple would be a world-altering turning point in redemptive history.
- Historical records between the resurrection and AD 70 confirm the rise of pretenders, threats of war, famines, and earthquakes.
- Jesus explained that these catastrophic events were merely the initial birth pains rather than the final consummation.
- Christians are cautioned against treating contemporary disasters as signs of the immediate end, focusing instead on sharing the gospel faithfully.

### Power Point - August 2, 2005
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-august-2-2005-1343339.html
Passage: Mark 13:5-8
Points:
- Growing darkness and moral confusion in culture indicate that believers live in spiritually critical times.
- Jesus described coming upheavals as birth pains that rapidly increase in frequency and intensity.
- Spiritual deception spreads as false teachers and counterfeit religious movements distort biblical truth.
- Escalating wars and natural catastrophes serve as sober reminders of impending judgment.
- Believers must remain spiritually watchful and urgently share the gospel to lead others to Christ.
